newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah continues to firm.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah continues to firm.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah firmed further against the dollar in late morning trading on Monday on the back of a tighter money market and a peaceful start to the campaign for May 29 general elections, dealers said.
They said the money market was tighter as operators needed the rupiah to finance their dollar purchases last week.
Overnight money edged up to 13.0 percent from 10.5 percent and overnight swaps increased to 0.60/0.65 from 0.3/0.4.
Dealers said the peaceful start of the Sunday campaign helped calm the market, sparking operators to reduce long dollar positions ahead of the month-end.
One state bank dealer said operators were switching focus to the liquidity issue because spot will mature on Wednesday.
He said reasons to hold dollars seemed to weaken although the minority Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) was campaigning in Java on Monday. There have been no disruptions so far, however.
One Japanese bank dealer said spot rupiah was well capped at the 2,427.0 level after local dollar selling broke through the previous resistance level at 2,430 decisively.
But another foreign bank dealer said the market appeared to be mixed and volatile as people remained cautious during the three-week campaign.
One U.S. bank dealer said earlier the smooth start of the campaign on Sunday had led operators to cash out from dollars.
He said the dollar was overbought and people were trying to cash out for now on possible tight rupiah at month-end.
One-month swap was at 12.0/12.5, two at 24.25/25.50, three at 36.50/38.0 and six at 73.5/74.0 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,404/2,596 and the conversion band at 2,413/2,461 on Friday.
